description: Exposes the REAL outcome distribution of CraftingService.AttemptCraftAsync across skill/difficulty cells. Models a player who submits the UI-displayed (rounded-to-5) quantity — the common case when a user reads the recipe panel at face value. Outcomes: Success, UnexpectedResult (bonus), ComponentLoss (hard fail), NearMiss (soft fail, no loss), Discovery (rare variant unlock). Current math (v1): skill-check is a hard gate (below-required-skill is an instant NearMiss), once past gate the outcome depends ONLY on whether submitted qty is within ±5% of seeded-per-player qty. craftingSkill axis is preserved for future tuning and to verify the skill gate works as expected.
